results.content:
As Trump’s approval rating has fallen, the Senate map has expanded for Democrats. The Cook Political Report lists seven races—Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, Maine, Michigan, Ohio and Texas—as toss-ups.

Trump’s approval rating is underwater in all of those states, according to Civiqs, which has tracked it in every state since the start of second term in January 2025. Whether or not those numbers improve over the next two weeks could play a role in the outcome of those races. [...] Republicans are facing headwinds as they defend their majority, where they currently hold 53 seats to the Democrats’ 47.
